slides.title: Accessing Applications
slides.html:
• The applications available to you in your server are listed on the frontpage.
  • You can open the application by clicking the "Open" button.
  • There is also the "Docs" option. It links to a Product Guide in the Docs app.

slides.title: Using Applications
slides.html:
• Most applications have onboarding guides to walk you through every key feature.
  • You can also find Product Guides on this site to learn the basics quickly or Product Wikis to master them. Your identity in Deploy App serves as your id ('SSO') across all applications. Your role or access changes in Deploy App, it changes in all apps.
